FeaturesBuilt to Last

Built to
Last

You forget things because your head is full, not because you're a mess. The name of that restaurant from March, the gift idea from your sister's birthday, notes from a call two quarters ago; old context gets buried under new chats. You end every day unable to dig up what you knew six months back.

Built to
Last

You forget things because your head is full, not because you're a mess. The name of that restaurant from March, the gift idea from your sister's birthday, notes from a call two quarters ago; old context gets buried under new chats. You end every day unable to dig up what you knew six months back.

FADING CONTEXT

That detail from six months ago is gone for good.

BURIED IN OLD CHATS

You'd have to scroll back months to find it.

STARTING FROM ZERO

Every new conversation forgets what came before.

REPEATED QUESTIONS

You ask the same thing again because you forgot the answer.

NO SEARCHABLE PAST

You remember it happened, just not where.

LOST HISTORY

Old notes vanish the moment you switch apps or phones.
